_note: Yamaka: the ten yamaka titles ('CĂN SONG' …) are anchors paired in order with the root's ten yamakas (###); inside each yamaka, headings are paired by the Pāli name in brackets (nearest match in order). Numbering: vol. 1 Vietnamese 1485 onward = Thai [1495] onward (the Thai lacks [1485]-[1494]).
